jobs.description:
As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end. You will set the strategy, ship the work, measure the outcomes, and decide what to build next. This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.

The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.

💡 Interested in applying?

🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
  • AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
  • Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
  • Self-directed. You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
  • Curious about new tools as they ship. You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
  • Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
  • Content and copy production: blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
  • Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
  • Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
  • Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
  • Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

  • Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
  • Real AI-augmented work. Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
  • Email and lifecycle depth. You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
  • CRO chops. You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
  • Full-stack execution. Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
  • Hungry over knowledgeable. You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.
  • Sharp communication. You work async with US-based teams daily. Your writing is clear, your updates are concise, and you communicate without needing a meeting.
  • Time zone. Minimum 9 AM to 1 PM EST overlap. Some brands have tighter overlap requirements.
  • If your strongest work happened inside a small growth team rather than truly solo, and you owned a meaningful slice end to end, tell us how the work happened and we will figure it out together. The bar is real execution ownership, not titles.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Public proof of your AI-augmented work. A newsletter, YouTube channel, X presence, Substack, podcast, or personal site where you have written about or demonstrated your workflow.
  • Zero-to-one experience. You have built an audience, a brand, a community, or a product from nothing and grown it to meaningful scale.
  • WordPress ecosystem familiarity. You can stand up a site, install plugins, and ask the right questions. Several of our brands serve WordPress site owners, so this helps.
  • Specific revenue or growth wins. Numbers you can point to: ARR contribution, conversion lift, list growth, audience growth, revenue per send improvements.
  • A point of view on where marketing is going as AI continues to reshape the function, and proof you are actively investing in that direction.

Benefits

jobs.excerpt: Привіт! Ми, Honeytech, — динамічний, швидкозростаючий проєкт, що створив платформу з коміксами в азійській стилістиці та вже став № 1 у своїй ніші!
jobs.description:
Привіт!

Ми, Honeytech, — динамічний, швидкозростаючий проєкт, що створив платформу з коміксами в азійській стилістиці та вже став № 1 у своїй ніші! Уяви Netflix, але для коміксів — лише за кілька років ми зібрали 10+ мільйонів користувачів, кинули виклик гігантам з Південної Кореї й довели, що можемо будувати продукт світового рівня з України!

Попереду в нас ще більші виклики — ми не збираємося зупинятися у масштабуванні, запускаємо нові продукти та шукаємо націленого на результат User Acquisition Specialist на напрямок TikTok, який не боїться великих бюджетів й допоможе нам зростати!

Чому тобі сподобається працювати з нами?

  • 🌍 Масштаб і амбіції: ти приєднаєшся до № 1 проєкту у світі у своїй ніші. Ми активно масштабуємося та запускаємо нові підпродукти, тож тут завжди є куди зростати.

  • 💰 Бюджети:працюватимеш з 6-значними маркетинговими бюджетами на Tier-1 ринки.

  • 🤖 Процеси, які реально працюють: маємо власні підходи до закупки та активно впроваджуємо AI для автоматизації операційки.

  • 🚀 Твій ріст:отримаєш PDP-план, регулярні перформанс-рев’ю та відкрите обговорення цілей.

  • 🤝 Команда, з якою приємно працювати:ми маємо прозорі процеси, адекватний менеджмент і залучену команду з фокусом на результат.

Ти наш ідеальний новий колега, якщо маєш:

  • Досвід роботи в performance marketing від 1,5 року (з TikTok або Meta/Snapchat/Google).

  • Досвід роботи з маркетинговими бюджетами від 100K+/month.

  • Розуміння основних маркетингових метрик (CPA, CR, CPC, LTV, ROMI etc), вміння аналізувати та оцінювати вплив своїх дій на них.

  • Володіння англійською на рівні Intermediate або вище.

Якими задачами потрібно буде займатись:

  • Запускати рекламні кампанії на TikTok.

  • Аналізувати та відстежувати ефективність рекламних кампаній.

  • Брати участь у розвитку інфраструктури для автоматизації мережі.

  • Залучатися до брейнштормів для генерації нових ідей.

Твій шлях до нас:

  1. Спілкування з рекрутером.

  2. Інтерв’ю з User Acquisition Manager.

  3. Тестове завдання.

  4. Фінальне інтерв’ю за результатами твого ТЗ.

Далі наш рекрутер збирає рекомендації з попереднього місця роботи, й ти отримуєш свій офер! 🏆

Цікаво, що ще пропонуємо?

  • Remote First culture: повністю віддалена робота або можливість працювати з нашого офісу в Києві, що повністю обладнаний для роботи під час відключень світла, + можливість користуватися коворкінгом у Варшаві та Львові.

  • 20 робочих днів відпустки на рік (після 3 місяців співпраці) та до 30 днів sick leave з медичним підтвердженням. А також можливість трансферу робочих днів та days off у державні свята України.

  • Веселі тімбілдінги та корпоративні подорожі.

  • Програма HoneyFit — компенсація спортивних активностей та івентів, офлайн/онлайн тренувань тощо (по завершенні випробувального терміну).

  • Різноманітні можливості для навчання: доповіді спікерів у різноманітних напрямах, велика корпоративна бібліотека, компенсація зовнішніх курсів і, звичайно, уроки англійської мови + speaking clubs.

  • Допомога в релокації, оплата коворкінгів або допомога у придбанні зарядних станцій та облаштування home office (після 3х місяців співпраці).

  • Але найголовніше: Honeytech — це команда професіоналів, де кожний відчуває підтримку та досягає своїх цілей!

jobs.excerpt: Lumos is looking for a full-time NOC Engineer I – Outage Management.
jobs.description:
Lumos is looking for a full-time NOC Engineer I – Outage Management. The NOC Engineer I - Outage Management provides comprehensive support across the Lumos Core and Access Broadband Network, including IP, Transport, and Voice platforms. This role monitors network health, coordinates outage resolution, analyzes performance issues, and collaborates with engineering and operations teams to restore services quickly and maintain network reliability.

The NOC Engineer I – Outage Management, assists with outage isolation, third party ticket creation, chronic issue identification, root cause analysis, and customer or network fault resolution. This position requires strong analytical skills, the ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, and a commitment to delivering high quality support across all network layers.

The NOC team operates in a 24/7 environment, and this position will operate specifically on a 3rd shift schedule (11 pm to 7 am). Success in this role requires effective communication, attention to detail, and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues while partnering with Voice, IP, Transport, OSP, and Local Operations teams.

Why Lumos:

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

What You'll Do:

  • Coordinates network outages with Voice, Video, IP, Transport, OSP, and Local Operations teams to ensure quick and effective resolution.
  • Performs event notifications for internal teams, leadership, and external customers.
  • Assists with third party ticket creation and escalation for offnet outages.
  • Supports outage isolation, troubleshooting, and identification of chronic network issues.
  • Diagnoses and resolves escalated network performance problems and monitors impacted systems.
  • Provides technical and analytical support during root cause analysis and assists with action plan development.
  • Works customer and network trouble tickets to restore service and resolve faults.
  • Assists other NOC team members during critical outages and provides support across Voice, Transport, IP, and Broadband networks.
  • Supports Change Management activities when needed.
  • Completes additional duties and project assignments as provided by NOC leadership.

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong understanding of Ethernet and TCP IP networking and working knowledge of IEEE and ITU standards for FTTH and GPON technologies.
  • Ability to troubleshoot Access and Core engineering environments and support MPLS, layer two and layer three private networks, GPON and XGS PON networks, and multi protocol routing technologies.
  • Familiarity with the OSI model and how it applies to routing and transmission protocols including VRF, VPN, EIGRP, BGP, OSPF, VPLS, and VPRN.
  • Knowledge of digital cross connect systems, multiplexing systems, and TL1 or CLI based provisioning.
  • Working knowledge of TDM, SONET, CWDM, DWDM, OTN, ROADM, and protection or switching methodologies.
  • Experience with Cisco, Ciena, Nokia routing platforms and the ability to support software or hardware upgrades across broadband access and core equipment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to deliver clear updates during outages or escalations.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize work in a fast paced environment and collaborate effectively across technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with sound judgment and initiative.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • High school diploma required and an Associate or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 2-4+ years of professional network operations experience or five or more years of related engineering or technical experience.
  • CCNA certification preferred.
  • Ability to work a 24/7 operational schedule including nights and weekends.
  • Strong commitment to service quality, customer support, and operational excellence.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequently operates computer, keyboard, and related peripherals.
  • Able to remain seated at workstation for extended periods.
  • Near-constant use of sight, speech, hearing, comprehension, and reasoning.

jobs.description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

About the Role

Fifth Third Bank is seeking a Director of Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Management to lead two critical cybersecurity functions: Enterprise Vulnerability Remediation and Exposure Analysis & Coordination.

This leader is responsible for reducing enterprise cyber risk by driving vulnerability remediation and coordinating the response to significant technology exposures across the Bank. The role combines strategic leadership and operational execution, partnering with senior technology leaders to prioritize remediation efforts, improve exposure management processes, and strengthen the Bank's cybersecurity posture.

In addition to leading the vulnerability remediation program, this Director will help mature a growing Exposure Analysis & Coordination capability focused on rapidly assessing and coordinating the Bank's response to emerging cybersecurity risks that require urgent action and cross-functional engagement.

This is a highly visible leadership role that partners closely with Information Security, Technology, Risk Management, and executive leadership.

What You'll Do

Lead Enterprise Vulnerability Remediation

  • Lead the enterprise vulnerability remediation program, including governance, reporting, escalation, and stakeholder coordination.

  • Partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to drive timely risk reduction.

  • Establish remediation priorities, performance metrics, and service-level expectations.

  • Support audits, regulatory examinations, and enterprise risk governance activities.

  • Continuously improve remediation workflows, reporting, and prioritization processes.

Lead Exposure Analysis & Coordination

  • Lead the Bank's Exposure Analysis & Coordination function.

  • Coordinate enterprise response to significant technology exposures, including:

    • Zero-day vulnerabilities

    • Emerging and pre-CVE threats

    • Vendor advisories

    • Third-party technology exposures

jobs.excerpt: Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterpriseThe next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own.
jobs.description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Technical PreSales Manager – Channel Partners
Organization: Intelligence Center X (ICX), Americas

Reports to: VP, PreSales – Americas

Position Summary

As part of the Americas PreSales management team, leads a team of technical and business development resources dedicated to the Channel Partner ecosystem. The team's mission is twofold: enabling partners to independently position, demonstrate, and deliver the Intelligence Center X (ICX) product suite, and supporting channel sales representatives in active pursuits — in direct service of the goal of 50% of revenue through the channel.

The manager's job is to build the team, the operating system, and the relationships that allow their people to succeed — and to personally own the hardest part of the channel environment: navigating competing demands from partners, channel sales, and internal Siemens organizations, and making the prioritization calls their team cannot make for themselves.

The Leadership Mandate

The channel presales function today operates without dedicated leadership — capable individuals working in isolation, deal-by-deal, without a system behind them. This role is chartered to change that by providing:

  • Direction — a clear vision, identity, and operating model for the team; explicit priorities so team members know what to say yes to and, just as importantly, what to decline.

  • Advocacy — representing the team's capacity, needs, and constraints upward and outward, so the function is resourced and positioned to succeed rather than stretched until it breaks.

  • Air cover — absorbing the organizational friction (escalations, competing stakeholder demands, priority conflicts) so the team can focus on partners and pursuits.

  • Development — coaching, career paths, and a talent pipeline that makes the team a destination rather than a way station.

Navigating a Multi-Stakeholder Environment

The defining challenge of this role is that the team serves several constituencies whose interests overlap but do not align. The manager is the integration point, expected to:

  • Balance partner needs against our own. Partners want maximum support and fastest enablement; the business needs partners to become self-sufficient so the team's capacity scales. The manager sets and defends the line between direct engagement and partner self-service, and holds it even when individual deals create pressure to cross it.

  • Balance enablement against pursuit support. Channel sales reps will always want the team in active deals; long-term scale requires protected investment in partner readiness. The manager owns this capacity allocation and is accountable for both outcomes, not just the urgent one.

  • Broker relationships with internal groups. The team's work intersects with Siemens enterprise presales, Xcelerator portfolio teams, vertical/industry organizations, and channel sales management. The manager builds the working relationships and operating rhythms that turn these groups into force multipliers rather than sources of friction — bringing channel and enterprise experts together on pursuits, negotiating shared account approaches, and resolving conflicts over ownership and credit before they land on the team.

  • Manage competing definitions of success. Partner leadership, channel sales, and ICX leadership each measure this team differently. The manager reconciles those expectations into a coherent set of priorities and communicates trade-offs transparently in all directions.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Establish the team's vision, identity, and operating model; build a culture of collaboration, accountability, and coaching.

  • Manage personnel decisions including recruitment, training and development, and performance management, in line with relevant regulations.

  • Coach team members in the development and delivery of partner enablement and customer-facing engagements; develop future leaders and improve engagement, morale, and retention.

  • Establish career paths and a scalable talent pipeline, including alignment with early-career programs.

Operating Model & Governance

  • Design repeatable engagement frameworks that define how and when the team engages — partner enablement, co-sell support, and direct pursuit support — with clear entry and exit criteria.

  • Create consistent operating rhythms with channel sales and partner leadership; review key pursuits and accounts, agreeing a common approach and priorities.

  • Manage business operations including budget/cost control, business planning, monitoring, and reporting.

Partner & Sales Alignment

  • In partnership with sales executives and management, contribute to the sales pipeline strategy, understanding the PreSales contribution requirements across partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and co-sell motions.

  • Oversee the partner onboarding-to-productivity journey — training, certification, and readiness programs — delivered by the team, with the manager accountable for its design and outcomes.

  • Move the engagement model from transactional, deal-by-deal support toward shared planning, account continuity, and trusted long-term relationships.

Ecosystem Integration

  • Build durable partnerships with Siemens enterprise presales and Xcelerator portfolio teams; establish account planning and attach motions across adjacent portfolio areas.

  • Participate in relevant Zone-level meetings and councils, contributing to planning and reporting; contribute to global initiatives originating from agreed council priorities and strategy.

Success Will Be Measured By

Partner-sourced pipeline and revenue growth; partner time-to-productivity; partner technical readiness; team capacity and coverage across the ICX product suite; cross-portfolio pipeline from the Siemens ecosystem; team engagement, retention, and talent development; and contribution to the 50% channel revenue goal.

Qualifications

  • Proven people-leadership experience with technical teams — building culture, coaching, and developing talent — ideally in a presales, solutions consulting, or partner enablement context.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a matrixed, multi-stakeholder environment: negotiating priorities across sales, partner, and product organizations, and managing up, down, and sideways with equal skill.

  • Experience with channel/partner sales motions and partner economics; understands the tension between enabling partner independence and supporting near-term deals.

  • Ability to build scalable programs and operating models rather than deliver individual engagements; technical credibility across enterprise software sufficient to earn the team's and partners' respect, without needing to be the deepest expert in the room.

Overview:

Quinnipiac University is seeking an enthusiastic, relationship-driven Part-Time Temporary Regional Admissions Recruiter to serve as the University's representative throughout Northern New Jersey during the undergraduate recruitment cycle. Quinnipiac University is a private, coeducational institution located 90 minutes north of New York City and two hours from Boston. The university currently has an enrollment of 9,700 students in more than 100-degree programs through its Schools of Business, Communications, Computing & Engineering, Education, Health Sciences, Law, Medicine, Nursing and the College of Arts & Sciences. Our 22 Division I teams have achieved remarkable success, boasting national and conference titles - including a 2023 NCAA national championship win in men's ice hockey, a trip to the Sweet 16 for our women's basketball team and NCAA Tournament appearances by many of our programs. The Quinnipiac University Poll is nationally recognized as a leader in public opinion research, and the university is consistently recognized by U.S. News & World Report and Princeton Review. The Wall Street Journal ranked Quinnipiac #51 among the best colleges in the nation, and second in Connecticut, for our exceptional graduation rate, salary impact, learning facilities, career preparation and learning opportunities.

The university is in the midst of program expansion and renewal for both traditional and adult learners, the development of innovative strategic partnerships, and recently opened South Quad with three state-of-the-art buildings.

As Quinnipiac grows, the university remains guided by the core values that define our community and shapes the experience of every student and employee.

  • We are fiercely committed to ensuring every Bobcat thrives. We are a lifelong partner for every learner.
  • We passionately care about our community. Everyone should feel welcome and valued.

These values are the foundation of who we are and reflect the Quinnipiac spirit found across our campuses. For more information, please visit qu.edu. Connect with Quinnipiac on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and X.

Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.

Position Overview:

The Loan Closer is responsible for the preparation of mortgage closing documents. In addition, the Loan Closer is responsible for ensuring all essential information is accurate while communicating with internal staff as well as settlement agents to solve all closing issues in a timely manner.

This position operates within Pacific Standard Time Zone working hours to support the West Coast region.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Understand and follow all closing procedures to comply with all Federal and State requirements.
  • Check accuracy for all essential information provided at submission for closing.
  • Communicate with loan officer, processing, and underwriting staff.
  • Prepare accurate figures for monthly payments, escrows, prepaid interest, etc.
  • Produce and organize all closing documents including conventional, FHA, VA, and USDA loans.
  • Review loan documents to ensure they meet all regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Prepare Closing Disclosure and validate all fees are accurate on Final CD, balance wire with escrow/title, review executed loan documents to provide funding authorization.
  • Act as the point of contact from the time closing is requested through the time the loan is shipped to one of our approved agencies or purchased by the investor.
  • Complete a loan review on every loan to ensure it is compliant with TRID disclosure and re-disclosure requirements, and Fair Lending, Reg B and other Federal or State requirements.
  • Maintain a closing pipeline, complete closing documents within 48 hours of request for refinance and 24 hours for purchase, deliver the documents in advance of the closing, adhere to wire cut-off times, work with branch to clear errors on files and timely delivery of complete closed loan files.
  • Follow up on requests from post-closing timely, including providing corrected documents, including Post Consummation CD and refund to borrower(s) when applicable.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 5 years’ mortgage document experience in preparing mortgage loan closing documents, preferred.
  • Knowledge of multiple investors closing policies and procedures. Knowledge of RESPA, TILA, Fair Lending, Flood and State laws and regulations, preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Encompass experience, preferred.

We are seeking an experienced API Solution Architect with strong Node.js expertise to design, develop, and modernize enterprise-scale API solutions. This role will lead the architecture of secure, scalable, and high-performing APIs while driving API transformation and integration initiatives across cloud-native platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Node.js, API architecture, microservices, and modern integration patterns, along with experience designing agentic API migration factories utilizing chained LLM-driven pipelines with human-gated PR reviews.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product owners, engineering teams, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into modern API-led solutions.

  • Implement and enforce API security best practices, including OAuth2, JWT, SSO, encryption, rate limiting, and threat mitigation controls.
  • Lead API lifecycle management processes including design, documentation, versioning, deployment, observability, and governance.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and integrate API management platforms such as Apigee, Kong, AWS API Gateway, MuleSoft, or equivalent technologies.
  • Guide development teams on microservices architecture, domain-driven design, event-driven systems, and asynchronous communication models.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, performance engineering, and scalability testing frameworks to ensure APIs consistently meet SLAs.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural guidance for engineering teams focused on modern API development and AI-assisted engineering practices.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineering teams to implement CI/CD pipelines, automated quality controls, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5+ years in Solution Architecture, Principal Architecture, or Enterprise Architecture roles.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express.js, NestJS, and Fastify.
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale API platforms and integration architectures.
  • Proven experience modernizing legacy applications and APIs using cloud-native and microservices-based approaches.
  • Experience building or leveraging LLM-powered automation, AI-assisted development frameworks, GitHub Copilot customization, or agentic engineering workflows.
  • Deep understanding of REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket’s, and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of API security, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, caching, and governance frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or equivalent platforms.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Strong understanding of Agile, Lean, DevOps, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cloud certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional Architect.
  • Experience implementing enterprise AI platforms, generative AI solutions, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience developing and governing custom GitHub Copilot Skills, Prompt Engineering standards, and AI development accelerators.
  • Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Event Bridge, or other event-streaming technologies.
  • Familiarity with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or New Relic.
  • Experience with API monetization, developer portals, and API product management.
  • Background supporting large-scale enterprise digital transformation, financial services, telecommunications, technology, or consulting environments.
  • Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and large modernization programs.

You are part business analyst, part automation engineer, part AI workflow designer, and part implementation consultant. You are measured by what ships — not what is scoped.

What You Will Do

  • Process Transformation — Map broken processes, identify inefficiencies, and redesign how teams operate. Convert vague business problems into structured workflows, dashboards, and system changes.
  • AI & Automation Implementation — Build real AI-powered workflows for lead research, reporting, CRM updates, support automation, document processing, and internal assistants. Using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, UiPath, and APIs.

  • Data, Reporting & Dashboards — Analyze business data, build Advanced Excel dashboards, create KPI reports, and give leadership clean, actionable data to make faster decisions.
  • Portfolio Enablement— Work across multiple acquired SaaS companies to standardize processes, automate workflows, and build scalable operating models. New business, new problem, every week.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years in Business Analysis, Automation, Digital Transformation, Operations, or Systems Implementation
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms — Make, Zapier, n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or similar
  • Active experience with AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or other LLM platforms
  • Ability to design AND build AI-enabled workflows end to end
  • Advanced Excel — formulas, Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, dashboards, data validation
  • Experience with CRM, Helpdesk, ERP, HRMS, or project management tools
  • Good understanding of APIs, integrations, and data flows
  • Strong documentation skills — SOPs, process maps, implementation plans

  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step agentic workflows

You Will Thrive Here If...

  • You see a messy business problem and want to fix it — not just describe it
  • You have automations running in production right now
  • You pick up new tools fast without waiting for full documentation
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and know how to ask the right questions
  • You follow through — builds do not sit half-finished on your list
  • You treat Sales, Support, Finance, and HR as equally interesting territory

Why Join Us

  • Real AI projects that go live in real businesses — not sandbox demos
  • Exposure to multiple B2B SaaS companies across industries

jobs.description:
Enertiv is a leading proptech SaaS platform that integrates hardware-enabled data collection with AI-powered analytics to transform how commercial real estate portfolios are operated. Our technology enables owners and operators to reduce operating costs, improve sustainability, and deliver enhanced tenant experiences.

Enertiv was built for this moment. We deliver both portfolio (hundreds of buildings) level solutions, such as automating the reporting and compliance work that consumes most sustainability teams today. From there, 15+ years of experience deploying on site solutions gives us something no pure reporting platform can offer: the ability to move from problem to solution. We have generated $40M+ in no-cost operational insights across our client portfolios and completed asset tagging on 17,000+ pieces of equipment to ensure alignment between long term decarbonization and required capital investments.

Solutions Engineer

Reports to: VP of Growth

Location: Full Time, US Remote, minimal travel. Colorado-based strongly preferred and considered first.

Compensation: $125,000 base + equity

Benefits: outlined below

The Role

We're hiring a Solutions Engineer to work closely with our Account Executives and Account Managers to win and expand high-value commercial real estate accounts. This role is involved in the full sales cycle and customer journey, including technical discovery, running engaging and effective demos, generating proposals, crafting RFP responses, and supporting negotiations. You'll bring an AI-first mindset to streamline and automate processes and workflows related to the role.

You'll deeply understand Enertiv's hardware and software capabilities and join sales calls as a reliable and trustworthy resource. When a buyer or technical evaluator wants to get into the details, you're the person who can go there.

What You’ll Own

Technical Discovery & Demos

  • Deeply understand each customer's specific scenario and Enertiv's software platform to tailor a demo that "solves exactly" — whether related to building management system optimization, tenant utility billing, ESG reporting, equipment-level monitoring, shadow metering, and more.
  • When a buyer says "your product doesn't do this," find the way it can deliver on the outcome they're looking to achieve.

Quoting, Proposal & RFPs

  • Own quoting and proposal generation: define what will actually be implemented, including which modules, hardware quantities, and relevant integrations.
  • Exercise the right instincts on how and when to request deviations from the standard pricing model.
  • Take the lead on RFP responses and other technical documentation when the company decides to respond.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Maintain an effective working relationship with the operations team, ensuring a tight feedback loop between what is being quoted and what ends up being deployed, to continuously refine the pricing model and limit change orders.

Process Rigor & AI-First Execution

  • Automate everything possible while taking responsibility for ultimate outputs.
  • Maintain clear reporting and CRM hygiene.
  • Communicate sharply, both internally and externally.
  • Forecast accurately and maintain accurate CRM records.

Performance Expectations

Team Quota

  • You will be measured to the extent that Account Executives and Account Managers achieve their combined quotas

Deal Support & Sales Cycle Impact

  • Improve our current conversion rates from sales accepted to sales qualified, and from qualified to closed won by 10% or more
  • Responses to external emails where your response is required within 24 hours

Quoting & Proposal Turnaround

  • Own the quoting automation and proposal generation. 100% of quotes expected to be completed 48 hours before proposal review
  • Turn around RFP responses within the timeline committed to the deal owner, with zero missed submission deadlines
  • Keep change orders resulting from quote-to-deployment mismatches under a defined threshold (e.g., <10% of deployed deals)

Forecasting & CRM Hygiene

  • Maintain 90%+ accuracy (by dollar amount) on quoted scope vs. final deployed scope
  • Keep all quoting, proposal, and RFP activity logged in CRM in real time, with no stale or missing records

Cross-Functional Feedback Loop

  • Meet regularly with Operations to reconcile quoted vs. deployed specs and close gaps
  • Surface pricing model or product-fit issues to leadership proactively

What Success Looks Like

  • Reliable partner of sales, instilling confidence and trustworthiness with prospects
  • Delivery is predictable, disciplined, and transparent.
  • Teams and partners operate with clear ownership and accountability.
  • Leadership has confidence in operational commitments and reporting.
  • The organization relies on systems and standards.

Qualifications & Skills

  • At least a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
  • At least 3-5 years of experience in operations, project delivery, or engineering services, ideally within hardware-enabled SaaS, IoT, energy management, or industrial technology environments
  • Strong command of project management tools, CRM dashboards, and data reporting platforms
  • Effective working style across executive leadership, sales, and operations
  • Proven ability to propose solutions in the context of an enterprise sales process

Location

Full time, US Remote, minimal travel. Colorado-based candidates strongly preferred and considered first.

Compensation

$125,000 with potential performance bonus and equity.

We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support your health, growth, and flexibility. Employees can choose from multiple medical plan options (HSA and PPO), plus dental and vision coverage, company-paid life insurance, and access to a 401(k). Eligible team members participate in performance-based bonuses and equity opportunities. We provide a company laptop and home office stipend, flexible PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid parental leave, and hybrid/remote flexibility. You’ll also benefit from monthly Lunch & Learns, professional development support, and a $2,000 referral bonus for successful hires.

Qualifications

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date client data, activities, and health indicators in Customer Success tools (e.g., Gainsight, Salesforce, Jira).

  • Follow standardized cadences for touchpoints, EBRs, and internal reviews to drive consistency and accountability across your portfolio.

  • Develop clear success plans that define client objectives and track progress, ensuring clients achieve their desired outcomes.

  • Advocate for client needs and escalate critical issues to internal leaders and departments, ensuring their voice is heard and their challenges are addressed.

  • Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing by documenting best practices, playbooks, and repeatable approaches that improve the overall Client Success motion.

  • Be willing to travel up to 25% as needed to meet client and business requirements.

Required

  • Experience serving as a primary consultative partner for B2B clients, ideally in SaaS, martech, adtech, or data-driven marketing.

  • 5-7+ years of relevant experience in Client Success, Account Management, Marketing Strategy or related client-facing roles

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data and insights to inform marketing strategies, campaigns, and optimization recommendations.

  • Proven success in independently managing a diverse portfolio of clients and prioritizing time across varied sizes, complexities, and lifecycle stages.

Preferred

jobs.description:
At Mindera, we don’t just "write code."

We build products we are proud of, with people we love. Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do. We partner with our clients to deliver high-performance, resilient, and scalable systems that impact users and businesses worldwide.

We are a collection of individuals with different stories, but one shared goal: to build a place where we actually want to work. We value empathy, self-organization, and the courage to take risks. If you love solving complex problems and believe that teaching others is the best way to learn, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role & The Challenge

We are looking for seasoned Senior .NET Developers who thrive in complex engineering environments, enjoy solving challenging technical problems, and take ownership of the software they build.

Reliability and quality are fundamental to our platform, so we're seeking product-minded engineers with proven experience in cloud-native distributed systems and a strong sense of ownership throughout the software development lifecycle.

In this role, you'll be expected to contribute to architectural decisions, clearly articulate the trade-offs behind your technical choices, and take features from business refinement through implementation, deployment, and production monitoring. You'll work with modern engineering practices to build decoupled, maintainable systems that scale reliably in production.

Your role goes beyond writing C# code. You are expected to own the delivery pipeline end to end:

  • Refinement: Challenge ambiguous business requirements, analyze acceptance criteria, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Architecture: Design decoupled, scalable solutions using Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) patterns.
  • Execution: Write highly concurrent, thread-safe applications using .NET 8 or later, with a strong preference for composition over inheritance.
  • Verification: Treat Test-Driven Development (TDD) as an essential engineering practice by writing robust unit and integration tests using xUnit and WireMock to prevent regressions.
  • Delivery & Operations: Deploy through modern CI/CD pipelines and proactively monitor production telemetry using tools such as AWS CloudWatch, New Relic, and GitHub Actions to ensure rapid troubleshooting and operational excellence.

The Tech Stack

  • Core: C#, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core
  • Architecture: Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Distributed Systems
  • Cloud & Messaging: AWS (ECS, EC2, SQS, SNS, S3)
  • Databases & Caching: SQL, NoSQL, Redis, Valkey, DynamoDB
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub Actions, TeamCity
  • Quality Assurance: xUnit, WireMock, SpecFlow

Requirements

You’ll be a Great Fit If...

  • Engineering Seniority: Solid experience designing and deploying complex, high-throughput backend systems using .NET.
  • Cloud-Native Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with AWS, particularly containerized workloads (ECS/EC2) and messaging services (SQS/SNS).
  • System Design Mastery: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, dependency injection lifetimes, and the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline.
  • Concurrency Discipline: Expert knowledge of asynchronous programming in C#. You understand how the thread pool works and why synchronous blocking (for example, using `.Result` or `.Wait()`) can severely impact the scalability and reliability of web APIs.
  • API Design: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, idempotent operations, and global exception-handling strategies.
  • Communication: Advanced or fluent English, with the ability to clearly communicate architectural decisions and technical trade-offs to stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

It’s a Total Bonus If...

  • Production experience with streaming platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or RabbitMQ.
  • Strong understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures.
  • Practical experience with LLMs and Generative AI using .NET or Python, particularly for AI-assisted engineering workflows and SDLC automation.

Benefits

Being a "Minder" in Brazil

We value commitment, feedback, and empathy. To support your journey, we offer:

  • Work Your Way: Flexibility to choose where you work from (Remote-first culture).
  • Growth Mindset: Free English lessons and continuous training/learning opportunities.
  • Well-being First: Access to counseling and psychotherapy services, and incentives in sports competitions, because your mind matters.
  • Shared Success: Annual profit distribution (subject to company performance and board decision - only for CLT contracts).
  • The Fun Stuff: Gatherings and annual trip to bond with the team.
  • Culture of Trust: A collaborative, lean, and self-managed environment where you have the autonomy to make an impact.

Find Us Around the Globe

While you'll be part of our Blumenau hub in Brazil, you’re joining a global family with offices in Australia | India | Morocco | Portugal | Romania | Spain | UK | USA | Vietnam.

Ready to be part of our journey? Check out our [Blog] and our [Handbook]!

Let’s build something amazing together!

  • As part of a new team, you will learn and expand your knowledge of health care economics, reimbursement, and the value of vaccines

US healthcare is moving towards value-based payments and risk-based arrangements between payers and providers. This risk-based arrangement shift is dramatically transforming healthcare providers’ traditional role to more effectively manage the new clinical and financial risks. The payment of our risk-bearing (RBO) customers is tied to cost-effective care.

SANOFI Vaccines, NORTH AMERICA created the Associate Director, Value Assessment Liaison role to seize the opportunity and engage our RBO customers in this fast-evolving risk-based landscape to identify, deliver, and drive the economic value across the health care system with our vaccine portfolio.

About Sanofi:
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Engage with C-suite level decision makers at Risk-based organizations (RBO) on the use of Sanofi portfolio

  • In this role, the Associate Director, Value Assessment Liaison will establish and sustain reliable company relationships in a fully compliant manner as per Sanofi Pasteur guidelines and FDAMA regulations, with C-suite decision makers such as CMO, CFO, Quality lead, etc.

  • Maximize the understanding of the economic value of Sanofi Vaccines products and demonstrate the clinical and economic value to customers in a compelling way according to their economic and clinical objectives. Initial focus will be RSV and Flu.

This requires the ability to understand RBOs business model, economic, clinical and quality structure, priorities, connections to other risk and non-risk organizations in the healthcare ecosystem and its impact on the Sanofi Pasteur portfolio.

    • Identify key decision makers within the RBO and map the decision-making flow, noting any overlaps with other Sanofi customers or providers.

    • Continuously assess alternative payment structures and care delivery models to identify the most appropriate targets in the assigned geographical area. Anticipate risk and trends specific to the market.

    • Identify strategy and tactics to payers if relevant.

  • Develop engagement strategy and tactics based on sound rational using available data sources, the collective intelligence of cross-functional teams and learnings from external sources (experts, conferences, other contacts)

  • Follow up and share output of engagement actions. Proactively share any relevant information which may impact Sanofi Vaccines strategy. Report on KPIs.

  • Contribute to adjust and update value proposition for the different types of RBOs to efficiently transition conversation from a simple cost of a product to include the product’s clinical and economic value. Value proposition includes health economics analysis, models, budget impact models, reimbursement arguments, clinical messages

  • Contribute to reviewing RBO strategy

  • Collect and share customer insight and identify unmet needs

Lead cross-functional relationship in the assigned geography with other customer-facing teams as well as with the head office

  • Proactively partner with Account Management, Pricing & Contracting, Marketing and MSL to align and best address customers’ needs

  • Develop training to educate internal stakeholders

Implement health economic and outcomes research to large, organized customers as part of the proactive customer-centric approach and create opportunities to differentiate Sanofi Vaccines

  • Identify and satisfy customers’ reimbursement and risk-bearing contracts needs

  • Adapt existing tools to a more health system focus

  • Proactive approach to detail holistic Sanofi Vaccines offering

  • Collaborate with Account Managers to identify customers` expectations

About You

  • Traveling up to 50% of time

  • 5+ years of experience in market access, payer engagement, or health economics related function (Vaccines a plus)

  • Demonstrated experience in account management and health system navigation

  • Maintain compliance with all applicable Sanofi policies and procedures, regulatory and legal requirements, and help to monitor compliance during cross functional team interactions

  • Vast understanding of commercial payer reimbursement and risk-barring methodology

  • Financial experience, vaccines understanding - Strong understanding of financial analysis/economic modeling

  • Develop and interpret content in keeping with client requests and needs in compliance with Sanofi guidelines

  • Attention to building and maintaining customer relationships to achieve success

  • Continually focuses on the performance and development of oneself and others to enhance the talent of the company

  • Exhibits strong analytical skills and decision-making expertise

  • Capacity and desire to analyze key learnings/ insights and convert to actions and outcomes

  • Inclusive & Diverse mindset in talent development, promotion and team dynamics and culture.

  • A valid driver’s license and safe driving record

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Comprehensive understanding of pharmaceutical industry; Buy & Bill experience is a preferred within Vaccine space

  • Executive level engagement and people leadership skills

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: 📍 Oslo / Bergen / Remote💰 Salary: 975 000 –1 145 000 NOKAt Aidn, we're building the next generation of health technology for Norwegian municipalities — nursing homes, home care, day centers, services young and old rely on every day.
jobs.description:
📍 Oslo / Bergen / Remote

💰 Salary: 975 000 –1 145 000 NOK

At Aidn, we're building the next generation of health technology for Norwegian municipalities — nursing homes, home care, day centers, services young and old rely on every day. Today, we offer the best EHR (Electronic Health Record) in Norway and are the market leader in the municipal healthcare sector. We've won 100% of the tenders we've participated in, a testament to the strength of our product and design. It would be hard to overstate how rewarding this journey has been — and it is just the beginning.

As Aidn matures from startup to industry leader, the next few years will be ambitious, even by the standards of some of the most driven people around. We're not just maintaining a great product, we're discovering how to serve many different professional groups well, at a scale we haven't operated at before. To make this happen we need people who care deeply about crafting excellent user experiences and want to make our users work day smoother.

Sound exciting? Let's dive in.

How we design at Aidn

Our work shapes how people experience providing care — helping them work smarter, with less stress, so they can care for more people. We're visiting nursing homes and municipal offices constantly: following a home nurse for a day, sitting in on medication rounds, watching how people actually use our product on a busy Tuesday. We'd rather learn from real use early than perfect something in a mockup first, so we get in front of our users early and often.

We've collected 26 amazing, experienced designers who work across service design, UI design, content design, product design, and design systems. We don't require a healthcare background, designers at Aidn dig in, do the research, and learn the domain by working directly with our users. We partner closely with engineers and product, designing together and learning in real time, not only from our users but from each other.

Each team has a Trio — a product manager, a tech lead, and a design lead working together to ensure the product is viable, valuable, and desirable. The design lead is accountable for the user experience and maintains design quality and standards across their product area. To support product teams, we have a Content Designer, a Design System team, Product Operations, Data Analysts, and in-house medical professionals who bring domain expertise and help teams make better decisions.

We're so proud to have won the IXDA Hedersprisen and the DOGA-merket in recognition of our design. These awards matter because they validate what we believe: that excellent, thoughtful design that starts with real users, respects their context, and refuses to compromise on clarity actually changes how people work. We won them because we're obsessive about how people actually work, and we design accordingly.

All of this combined with excellent designers means we have the highest usability score in the Norwegian market.

What you'll be working on

We have a team that focuses on the red thread: navigation, information architecture, personalization, the landing page, the command bar — how people move through and experience the product.

This includes:

  • Structuring and evolving navigation and information architecture across a large, complex product.

  • Designing personalization: making sure the right information reaches the right role at the right time, across many distinct user types.

  • Creating user-centered, accessible designs aligned with Aidn's design system and product principles.

  • Prototyping and testing with real research behind it, working closely with engineers to bring designs to life.

  • Communicating design decisions clearly, since this work touches nearly every other team in the product.

Who you are

You're an experienced designer who's comfortable owning a complex, cross-cutting problem, and who works well both independently and in close collaboration with others.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just use AI to write documents, but who's comfortable building with it. We expect you to prototype real, working software with agentic tools, automate parts of your own workflow, and know where AI creates and doesn't create genuine user value.

You likely have:

  • 8+ years of design experience. Product, UX, UI, service, or digital design.

  • Information architecture experience. You've structured or restructured navigation or IA for a complex product and specialized systems, ideally across multiple product areas.

  • A feel for personalization. You've designed products that adapt to who's using them, based on role, context, or behavior.

  • You use AI regularly as part of your work.

  • Strong user-centered design skills. Research, testing, iteration.

  • The ability to communicate complex ideas simply, to a wide range of stakeholders.

It’s a plus if you've:

  • Worked in SaaS or high-paced product environments.

  • Familiarity with healthcare, welfare services, or municipal systems.

Personal qualities:

  • Self-driven and proactive

  • Comfortable with ambiguity

  • Empathetic and user-focused

  • Pragmatic, positive, and solution-oriented

What success looks like

After 3 months

  • You've built strong relationships with your trio and team, and have a solid grasp of how navigation threads through the wider product.

  • You're actively creating and iterating on navigation and IA solutions using the design system.

  • You're participating in user research with clinicians and case handlers.

After 6 months

  • Your designs clearly support user and business goals, with measurable outcomes.

  • You have a clear point of view on navigation and IA patterns across the product.

After 12 months

  • You're seen as the go-to for navigation and IA expertise, not just within your team but across others.

  • Users and municipal staff experience a clear improvement in how they navigate and interact with the product.

  • The team has visibly raised its bar on how it uses AI in everyday product work.

Why you'll love working here

High trust, real ownership

You'll be the sole designer on your team, with real autonomy to shape solutions and take responsibility for meaningful design work.

Visible impact

Your work will directly affect how healthcare professionals and municipalities across Norway do their jobs every day, on a part of the product that touches nearly every user.

A strong design environment

You'll join a design organization of 26 designers, with dedicated design leadership, a design system team, and a culture that values quality and craft.

AI as a core tool

You'll actively incorporate AI into your design and research work — experimenting with agentic tools, automating parts of your workflow, and helping define what responsible AI use looks like in design.

Perks and benefits

  • 6 weeks vacation

  • Flexible working hours and location

  • Employee stock option program

  • Pension, insurance, and full pay during parental leave

  • Approx. 20 travel days per year (team days, events, user visits)

Interested? We don't ask for cover letters. Upload your CV or share your LinkedIn profile, and share a portfolio (a link or a PDF works) along with what made you curious about this role.

👉 Application deadline: Friday, September 4th, 2026.

Aidn is part of theKernel cooperation, where we build technology for the next generation of welfare societies. With financial backing in order, we are privileged to be a fully autonomous startup busy building our company from the ground up the way we see fit.

Aidn recognizes and celebrates diversity in all its forms, visible and non-visible in all areas of the work environment. We work to promote an anti-discriminatory environment where everyone feels safe and welcome.

Job Title: Senior Business Analyst - FP&A Science RDU (GFS Americas)

Role Purpose

AstraZeneca is a global, innovation-driven biopharmaceutical business that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world's most serious diseases. But we're more than one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we're proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Global Financial Services (GFS) was formed in Q3 2018 through the merger of Global Finance Operations, Integrated Finance Solutions and Cash Generation. GFS is at the heart of the Finance function - accountable to the AstraZeneca (AZ) Group for the design and delivery of high quality, simple to operate transactional finance processes that enable our customers to focus on AZ’s strategic priorities.

The creation of the Global Financial Services (GFS) centers in Warsaw (Poland), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) and San José (Costa Rica) will transform the AZ Middle Office to a central function, supporting the business regions through simplification, standardization across the globe, and a structure that is scalable to support the bold ambition of becoming a $80bn company by 2030.

We have exciting opportunities to join our GFS Center in San José, which will establish best practices and be responsible for providing support to embedded finance.

Role Profile

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will collaborate with a team of 4-12 analysts to provide support for financial and planning activities. Your role is essential, involving assistance to the Finance Leads (manager and director) in accomplishing team objectives. Your knowledge in financial analysis, planning, and leadership will be instrumental in guiding the FP&A Science Business Analysts and driving continuous improvements.

You will act as the subject matter expert and primary point of contact for your team, helping with their daily tasks and fostering their professional growth. Moreover, your expertise may be leveraged to lead or contribute to special projects across GFS, collaborating with other Leads or Senior Analysts.

The Sr analyst is expected to behave as a positive leader and drive the organization along with the manager and the Director, acting as a change management agent.

Your core deliverables will include:

Deliver robust, high-quality month-end financial reports to business teams.

Support, prepare, and present planning cycles (Budget – forecast) to business teams, involving information gathering, providing constructive challenges, responding to ad hoc queries, and actively participating in business meetings to ensure alignment with market assumptions across all business areas.

Provide comprehensive financial input and analysis, enabling individuals and teams to make informed and effective business decisions.

Be SPOC for GFS FP&A Science team, to support the R&D Area finance main stakeholders (Area Finance Business Partner and BPOs).

Month End Close Activities

  • Execute month-end financial reporting and analysis accurately and promptly, including commentaries and business insights.
  • Insert JEVs for the P&L, ensuring compliance with necessary financial controls. Analyze complex financial information for trends, issues and opportunities and create action-oriented reporting to assist the Science Team understanding business results and trends.
  • Conduct comprehensive analysis of current, past, and future trends and scenarios related to expenses, cost centers, project allocation, and variance analysis across the P&L sections, offering actionable reporting to support the embedded finance team in understanding business results.

Planning and Forecasting Activities

  • Provide support and actively participate in the planning cycle processes (budgeting/forecasting) in adherence to internal guidelines, ensuring timely and accurate reporting
  • Address strategic issues on an ad hoc basis that are complementary to the regular planning and analysis processes

Area Responsibilities:

  • Approve JEVs and accruals as required; ensure compliance with manual journal entry policies; maintain and continuously improve standardized backup/supporting documentation to enable efficient review and audit readiness.

  • Serve as a point of contact for Functions and Corporate Finance on close, planning, and policy questions; facilitate clear, timely communication and resolution of issues.

  • Ad hoc queries may be required as needed.

  • Ability to operate with minimal direct supervision.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across diverse global teams.
  • Proficiency in the English language, both verbal and written, with the ability to articulate clear opinions and explain financial matters to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in SAP, Smart View/Hyperion Financial Management.
  • Excellent communication skills, conveying strategic and tactical concepts to various stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, and Senior Management.

Quantum Technology Solution (QTS) is the new business recently launched at GlobalFoundries to enable the Quantum industry to transition from lab-scale to Utility Scale Quantum Computing.

We are seeking a driven Product Manager to lead one of the foundation of our Quantum Technology Solution strategy – Cryogenic CMOS. This role is ideal for an experienced Product Manager with a strong background in quantum technology especially cyro-ASICs. This role will focus on adapting the existing GF CMOS technology platform for cryogenic applications including quantum control and read-out IC ASIC devices. Creating cryo-CMOS ASIC requires cryo-PDK’s, cryo-optimized devices and cryo-qualified IP titles relevant for cryo-ASIC applications. The cryo-CMOS offerings are qubit agnostic – they can interface to any modality required. The Product Manager will play a central role in translating the quantum systems requirements into product requirements that serves as the basis for the development cryogenic CMOS technologies.

The Product Manager for CryoCMOS is responsible for defining and commercializing GF's cryogenic semiconductor platform strategy by translating customer quantum system requirements into scalable product roadmaps, enabling technologies, ecosystem partnerships, and revenue-generating offerings that accelerate the adoption of cryogenic electronics

Essential Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the growth and profitability of cryogenic-CMOS platforms for the Quantum Technology Solutions (QTS) business

  • Define the CryoCMOS customer enablement roadmap including: Cryogenic PDK releases, Foundational IP portfolio, Standard cells, Memory IP, Analog and RF building blocks, Design flows, Reference architectures
  • Partner with engineering teams to establish the cryogenic test, characterization, qualification, and reliability roadmap.

Job Description

Join Us as a Associate Director, PVG

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

The Associate Director, PVG ensures the delivery of safety management services consistent with company SOPs/WPDs, ICH guidelines and regulatory requirements. Works with managers and liaises with other departmental personnel as required. Oversees function operations and manages the activities of managers and other staff. Develops and maintains departmental SOPs/WPDs, and long-range planning for new processes and staffing needs. Prepares business proposals and client presentations and interacts frequently with members of the Business Development and Bids and Contracts groups.

What You'll Do:

  • Oversee effectiveness of department operations to include safety processes, resource utilization, scope of work, budget and contractual issues.
  • Develop processes and strategies designed to assist in meeting departmental and company goals.
  • Oversee compliance with all relevant company policies, procedures and global regulations.
  • Guide managers and train project team members as appropriate.
  • Assist business development and foster client relationships and provide department business development presentations for clients to help secure new business as well as retain ongoing business for existing clients.
  • Review and provide operational input on budgets, proposals, contracts and/or renewals associated with existing clients.
  • Manage staff of experienced professionals, which may include interviewing and selection, job description preparation, professional development, goal setting, performance management, coaching and mentoring, employee counseling, and separations.
  • Approve courses of action on salary administration, hiring, corrective action, and terminations. Review and approve time records, expense reports, requests for leave, and overtime.

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 10+ years).
  • 5+ years of management responsibility
  • Proven leadership skills

In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Expertise in global regulatory requirements for adverse event reporting, ICH safety guidelines, GC etc.
  • Knowledgeable of safety database management
  • Expertise in budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management
  • Analytical skills as well as excellence in oral and written communications
  • Ability to handle multiple issues on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Know how to maintain a high degree of independence with respect to decision making and problem solving
  • Ability to act as liaison with other divisions necessary to complete contract/regulatory requirements
  • Strong negotiating skills
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate processes and procedures

Working Environment:
Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive.

Why join us?
When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

Nice-to-Haves
